items.title: dev.sh check --json has no test of its own
items.evidence: A test that runs ./dev.sh check would run the mutants, which copy the repo and run the tests again. The JSON contract ({"ok": bool, "gates": {...}}) is read by eye at each commit. The self gate also has no mutant: in a mutant copy it shares this repo's prefix and is red at baseline.
items.done_when: dev.sh check accepts a gate list, and a test runs it without mutants and parses the JSON
items.resolution: dev.sh check takes --json and a gate list; tests/test_dev.py runs files+audit, green and red, and parses the JSON; mutants check-json-ok-always-true and check-json-gate-always-true. The self-gate and guard mutant gap moved to td-11.

items.title: A report to the delegation layer stays unpaired forever
items.evidence: The scan never enters hidden folders (tests/test_store.py), so a store in .claude/ is never found and todo report --to .claude gives a counterpart-less WARN for good. Hinges on: whether the delegation layer keeps a todo.json at all, and if so whether the scan admits that one folder by name.
items.done_when: a report to that layer pairs, or the README says it never will
items.resolution: Never pairs, by design (PLAN §8 decision 4: todo never reads the delegation layer). report, check (INFO, not the unpaired WARN) and the render say so; init refuses a hidden repo name; README Across repos. tests/test_reports.py, four mutants.

items.title: Imported closed items may lack a resolution, which PLAN §5 says is red
items.evidence: PLAN-todo-tool.md §5 says a done without a resolution is red in check for imported items. A DONE bullet carries a date but no resolution field, and history is append-only with no edit command, so a red there could never be cleared. Built instead: check counts them as INFO and their evidence keeps the bullet text. Hinges on: accept the INFO (recommend), or let import copy the bullet text into resolution (a guess, which the rules prefer null over).
items.done_when: PLAN §5 records the choice and check follows it
items.resolution: Jacob 2026-10-04 (PLAN-todo-tool.md end, decision 11): imported closed bullets get resolution done-deprecated (vocab.json resolutions + roles.import_resolution); todo done refuses it; check fails a closed item without a resolution wherever it came from, and done-deprecated on an item not imported. 9843e2d; tests test_import, test_required.ImportResolution, test_vocab; seven mutants.

items.title: A change to the render format reads as a hand edit in every store
items.evidence:
render_state (todolib/checks.py) calls a TODO.md clean only when it equals the current render, and hand-edited when it differs but starts with the header. So any change to render.py's output turns every store holding an affected item red in check (WARN during the import grace, FAIL after), and every mutating command there refuses until 'todo render --force', which records a hand edit that never happened.
Seen 2026-10-04 on this repo: td-3 changed the reported_to line for a hidden repo; todo check then said 'TODO.md is edited by hand since it was rendered' for td-8, and render --force wrote a hand_edits entry for an edit nobody made. One store exists today, so it was re-rendered in the same commit; once other repos migrate, a format change lands in stores this repo does not commit.
items.done_when: a store rendered by an older render format is told so (stale render, re-render) rather than hand-edited, or the README says a format change needs every store re-rendered
items.resolution: fixed in 1fbfb2e: TODO.md carries a seal (a digest of the file without it); an unedited render of another store or format is a stale render (check FAIL saying so; todo render and mutations rewrite it, no hand edit recorded), never hand-edited. 7 tests, 7 mutants

items.title: The self gate and the check-nesting guard have no mutant
items.evidence: Carried from td-6. The self gate (./dev.sh self, todo check on this store) has none: in a mutant copy under .mutants/ the scan root is still the workspace, so the copy shares this repo's prefix and is red at baseline. The nesting guard in cmd_check (TODO_DEV_CHECK: a check inside a check refuses the test and mutants gates) has none either: with it broken, its own test runs the test gate, which runs that test again without end. Seen 2026-10-04: tests/test_dev.py run against the previous dev.sh (which ignored the gate list) did exactly that and had to be stopped. The guard is held by tests/test_dev.py only.
items.done_when: a mutant breaks the self gate and goes red without a red baseline, or the README says why it cannot
items.resolution: fixed in fd13e2e: mutants self-gate-quiet (planted bad store, ./dev.sh self with TODO_ROOT=. so the copy scans only itself) and check-nesting-unguarded (the guard's test runs in a stubbed copy, red not recursive), plus todo-root-ignored; 64 of 64 red

items.title: The reinstalled test-no-inline-blobs.sh names roster agents, so the direction audit is red
items.evidence: After reinstalling from tools/hooks/source on 2026-10-04 (533f484), ./dev.sh check: audit FAIL .claude/hooks/test-no-inline-blobs.sh:107 and :108, a provenance comment in the source naming two roster agents as reporters of the heredoc false positives. That turns 3 unit tests red (test_audit this_repo_is_clean, test_dev CheckJson x2) and 2 mutant baselines. The copy may not be hand-edited. Fix A (hooks owner): reword the source comment without the agent names, then reinstall here. Fix B (this repo's decision): skip roster_names, not patterns, under .claude/hooks/ in devtools/audit.json, with a test and a mutant.
items.done_when: ./dev.sh check passes the audit gate with the copies still byte-identical to tools/hooks/source
items.resolution: reinstalled from tools/hooks/source after its ae91098 dropped the agent names (be5b9af); ./dev.sh check audit green, copies cmp-identical

items.title: The hooks tool installs lib/write-targets.sh in a folder the direction audit bans here
items.evidence: 2026-10-05: cp -p tools/hooks/source/lib/write-targets.sh to its dest (the lib folder beside .claude/hooks; cmp equal), then ./dev.sh check audit: FAIL write-targets.sh:2, the 'delegation layer's folders' pattern in devtools/audit.json, matched by its own dest header. Not installed: only the four new hooks (bd0413c: ask-first, git-stamp, settings-guard, write-ledger) consume it, and those are not installed here yet; hooks copies lists it MISSING. Hinges on: devtools/audit.json skipping the installed copy (with a test and a mutant, as td-14 Fix B), or the hooks owner moving the lib's dest.
items.done_when: write-targets.sh is installed here byte-identical to tools/hooks/source and ./dev.sh check passes the audit gate
items.resolution: audit skips the installed copies (Jacob's answer); write-targets.sh installed cmp-identical to tools/hooks/source; ./dev.sh check green (6442a4d)

items.title: Three hook copies here drift from the shared source
items.evidence: setup (tools/setup 32aeaa9) on 2026-10-05 reported these three as drift (logic differs from tools/hooks/source) and left them byte-unchanged; hooks copies agrees. Replacing a drifted copy waits on Jacob (PLAN-repo-setup §7.12); --rebuild was not used.
items.done_when: hooks copies prints no DRIFT line for these three in tools/todo
items.resolution: rebuilt from tools/hooks/source 43d2a1e by setup --only hooks --rebuild in 5457dda (Jacob approved --rebuild, PLAN-repo-setup §7.12); hooks copies --gate tools/todo: ok

items.title: Three freshly installed hook tests read as DRIFT against uncommitted hooks source
items.evidence: On 2026-10-05 setup installed these from tools/hooks HEAD (cmp: identical), while tools/hooks had uncommitted edits to the same three sources plus an untracked tests/test_leak_shapes.py (no email-shaped literal in a committed line). hooks copies compares the working tree, so it reports them DRIFT here. Expected to clear when tools/hooks commits and setup is re-run.
items.probe: cd tools/hooks && git status --short source/hooks; ./hooks copies | grep tools/todo
items.done_when: hooks copies prints no DRIFT for these three after setup re-runs on a committed hooks source
items.resolution: tools/hooks committed (43d2a1e, clean tree); setup --rebuild rewrote the three in 5457dda; hooks copies --gate tools/todo: ok

items.title: Report to the todo repo: the work vocabulary has no kind for research, labour or outreach
items.evidence: Observed 2026-10-05 while seeding this store: works are code, test, audit, tooling, docs, decision. Gig driving, an appeal filing, a client proposal and a mail scan all had to be filed as tooling or docs. The local session runs todo report with --to todo so the counterpart lands in that store.

items.resolution: added works research, labour and outreach to vocab.json and the README works table (tests/test_vocab.py and test_docs.py green); inc-50's owner can close theirs and refile items under them
